english.title: Smoke in an enclosed place within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Heathrow Airport

(A)_[smoked in]_
(B)_[brought a naked light into]_
(C)_[lit a naked light in]_

an enclosed place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE ENCLOSED PLACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.6(b) and 2.1 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
